activation_gate.decision: Do not download, train, screen, promote, or compare SpatialMETA in v1.
activation_gate.minimum_future_evidence: Rights-cleared, participant-linked spatial transcriptomics and spatial metabolomics with authoritative section adjacency, coordinates, registration inputs, assay metadata, enough donors for grouped outer evaluation, and permission for training and derivative-weight redistribution.
activation_gate.task_gate: Register a modality-native cross-modal endpoint, independent alignment protocol, biological unit, baselines, power analysis, and genuinely external source before any superiority or champion claim.

gse192741.why: It can test spatial-RNA or registration plumbing but cannot exercise SpatialMETA's transcriptome-metabolome objective and cannot support donor-held superiority.

gse292268.biological_units: 4 F2 MASLD donors distributed two per CosMx slide
gse292268.why: No metabolite imaging is registered, the slide and field-of-view donor map is unresolved, and four donors cannot support the planned claim.

hra007511.biological_units: 61-participant union; 35 spatial participants; 27 of 35 spatial samples reportedly have MALDI; only 3 participants overlap scRNA and spatial
hra007511.why: Processed images and MALDI require permission, training and derivative-weight rights require written approval, section transforms and participant joins are not admitted, and outcomes are project-exposed.

vu2025.why: No MALDI or DESI metabolomics is registered. A data-sharing agreement, barcode-to-participant map, and complete transforms are also missing.

topology_contract.hra007511: Retain adjacent_section for spatial RNA and MALDI unless the source explicitly proves same-section measurement. Registration creates a transform and derivation, not a new observed topology.
topology_contract.same_participant: All sections, modalities, aliquots, transforms, and derived common-grid values from one participant remain in one outer fold.
topology_contract.same_study_unpaired: Do not create a cross-modal pair from two source records merely because they share a study accession or disease stage.
topology_contract.registration_uncertainty: Record mapping distance, transform identity, unmapped status, interpolation or aggregation, and uncertainty for each derived cross-modal observation.
topology_contract.biological_replication: Participants are replicates. Spots, pixels, ion peaks, sections, images, and KNN links are not independent participants.

held_donor_and_leakage_firewall.training_only: Gene and metabolite feature selection, scaling, batch categories, latent dimensions, loss weights, early stopping, spatial-variable statistics, and model selection are fit using training participants only.
held_donor_and_leakage_firewall.query_registration: A held participant may receive an outcome-blind transform under a locked algorithm, but this is query-specific transductive preprocessing and must be disclosed.
held_donor_and_leakage_firewall.circularity: Alignment and evaluation cannot optimize and score the same signals. Use outline or histology-only alignment, or a precommitted disjoint feature split.
held_donor_and_leakage_firewall.manual_steps: A held participant's fibrosis, inflammation, niche, molecular program, model residual, or endpoint cannot guide landmarks, transform choice, K, distance threshold, feature roster, or exclusion.
held_donor_and_leakage_firewall.unseen_batch: The frozen-lane policy for a held participant absent from decoder batch categories must be defined and tested before activation.

assay_native_contract.RNA: Model and score counts with the registered RNA likelihood and donor-aware units. Do not analyze metabolite intensities with the RNA count null.
assay_native_contract.metabolites: Model and score predeclared intensity transformations with Gaussian or zero-inflated Gaussian assumptions as appropriate. Record below-detection separately from structural missingness.
assay_native_contract.CODEX: Protein intensity is a distinct assay. It is not a metabolite channel without a new protein-specific measurement model and task specification.
assay_native_contract.H&E: Histology may supply outcome-independent registration information but is not a native decoded omic modality in the registered core model.
assay_native_contract.missingness: Use observed, structurally_missing, not_applicable, below_qc, unavailable_permission, join_unresolved, withheld_sealed, and derivable_not_processed. A missing modality or failed registration is never a zero-valued biological measurement.

training_and_exposure_crosswalk.target_exposure_interpretation: A future model trained only inside participant folds could be target_label_unexposed for held participants. HRA007511 outcomes already exposed to the project cannot become a pristine external source.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_future_gate_passes: Cross-modal reconstruction, alignment robustness, participant-held representation transfer, or spatial program association using assay-native endpoints and independent baselines.
claim_boundary.prohibited_now: Any v1 training result, model superiority statement, MASLD spatial-metabolomic champion, biological discovery, or claim that adjacent sections provide same-location paired truth.
claim_boundary.clinical: No diagnostic, prognostic, treatment-response, or deployment claim.

interpretation: SpatialMETA is a modality-matched future candidate only for participant-linked spatial RNA plus spatial metabolomics. Among registered MASLD sources, HRA007511 is the sole plausible substrate, but it is controlled, project-exposed, rights-blocked, and adjacent-section. The other spatial cohorts lack metabolomics and are not valid substitutes. SpatialMETA therefore remains deferred and cannot participate in the v1 tournament or earn a champion claim.
